{{Short description|Login solution in Denmark}}
'''MitID''' is the state-run [[Electronic identification|digital identification system]] for online platforms in [[Denmark]]. It is used to prove a person's identity when logging in to websites, especially those of the public administration, and at the end of 2021 it replaced the [[NemID]] system, which had established itself as the national [[Electronic identification|eID]] solution.<ref name="dr-2021-10-06">{{Cite web
 |author=Henrik Moltke; Adam Lebech; Michael Busk-Jepsen
 |url=https://www.dr.dk/engagement/taet-paa/stil-spoergsmaal-om-mitid
 |title=READ THE ANSWERS about MitID: This is why we need to replace NemID
 |website=dr.dk
 |date=2021-10-06
 |language=da
 |access-date=2024-01-13
}}</ref>

It was developed by the company ''Nets'' in cooperation with the Ministry of Digital Affairs and the Danish banks, and it is used by all public and private-sector services, such as insurance companies.

Together with the [[Personal identification number (Denmark)|personal identification number]], NemID and MitID significantly advanced digitalization in many areas, making many administrative visits unnecessary and even greatly reducing postal correspondence.

==History==
As early as 1999, the [[Danish government]] initiated a study on [[digital signature]]s, which formed the basis for NemID,<ref name="user-centric-security">{{Cite journal
 |author=Thomas Kingo; Diego F. Aranha
 |title=User-centric security analysis of MitID: The Danish passwordless digital identity solution
 |journal=Computers & Security
 |volume=132
 |date=2023-09-01
 |issn=0167-4048
 |doi=10.1016/j.cose.2023.103376
 |article-number=103376
 |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167404823002869
 |access-date=2025-03-07
}}</ref> introduced in 2010 and subsequently established as the national solution for digital identification.<ref name="dr-2021-10-06" /> NemID was based on the iTAN method.

Because the system was state-funded and not subject to market competition, and because the eIDAS Regulation required higher security standards, the NemID contract was terminated and the development of MitID was initiated.<ref name="dr-2021-10-06" />
The rollout of MitID began in October 2021, marking the transition phase from NemID to MitID.<ref name="dr-2021-10-06" /> From 22 September 2022, all citizens were required to use MitID to access public administration platforms, including the tax system (skat.dk), citizen services portals (borger.dk and LifeInDenmark.dk), and the healthcare system (sundhed.dk).<ref name="dr-2022-09-13">{{Cite web
 |author=Victor Emil Kuhlman Pedersen
 |url=https://www.dr.dk/nyheder/seneste/mitid-bliver-standardvalget-paa-flere-offentlige-hjemmesider
 |title=MitID becomes the standard choice on several public websites
 |website=dr.dk
 |language=da
 |date=2022-09-13
 |access-date=2024-01-13
}}</ref>
